people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
translations.bsb: So he got up and ate and drank. And strengthened by that food, he walked forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.
translations.kjv: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
translations.asv: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
